After the [[Declaration of a New Order]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] immediately '''blockaded''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Access to the planet was restricted to only those cleared by the [[Office of the Emperor]].<ref name="FaD" />
